label: Dispatch
description: Send a value to whichever branch claims it. Each branch is one input you add plus the output of the same name, which the compiler makes for you. A branch input is usually fed by a metadata port, and the value leaves on the output of the branch whose `by` field equals its own; every other output closes. The usual case is a model's tool calls: each tool is a group with a `*tool` metadata port, `route.search = search.tool` adds the `search` branch, and a call whose `name` is that tool's leaves on `route.search`, into the group. A value no branch claims leaves on `otherwise`, so wire it (to tell the model the tool does not exist, say). Two branches with the same `by` field, or a value or branch without one, fail the node.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The record to send on: one tool call from a Loop over an LLM node's `toolCalls`, say.

inputs.name: by
inputs.label: Match on
inputs.description: The field compared on both sides: the value's and each branch's.

outputs.name: otherwise
outputs.description: The value, when no branch's `by` field equals its own. Closed when a branch claims it.
